title: Repository onboarding path
alt: Five onboarding commands run in sequence to scaffold configuration, transpile context, record debt, and verify governance.
text: Onboarding commands, in order: 1. Scaffolding (praetorctl init), 2. Context Transpilation (praetorctl compile-context), 3. Brownfield Baselining (praetorctl baseline --record), 4. Devcontainer Setup (praetorctl devcontainer generate), 5. Audit Verification (praetorctl audit).
Boxes: Target repository (greenfield or brownfield), Governed repository (praetorctl audit pass).
Target repository → 1. Scaffolding (start) → 2. Context Transpilation → 3. Brownfield Baselining → 4. Devcontainer Setup → 5. Audit Verification → Governed repository (verified).

Scenario 1, init: Initialize configuration with declared profile and facets. Target repository is initialized with declared profile and facets. Scaffolding creates .standards.yaml, .standards.lock, and initial baseline.

Scenario 2, compile-context: Transpile universal agent harness from AGENTS.md. Canonical agent instructions in AGENTS.md are compiled. Transpilation generates vendor instruction files and splices the text register.

Scenario 3, baseline: Snapshot legacy technical debt into baseline file. HISS scanner sweeps the codebase for existing infractions. Legacy infractions are snapshotted into .standards-baseline.json to prevent CI failure.

Scenario 4, devcontainer: Prepare a portable devcontainer from reviewed Praetor sources. DevContainer configuration and reviewed source bundle companions are generated. Configuration, Dockerfile, and exact source companions are prepared in .devcontainer/.

Scenario 5, audit: Verify configured governance contracts and debt ratchet. Audit checks manifest, lockfile, agent context, debt baseline, and DevContainer. Every executed gate passes with zero files modified; repository is verified and governed.
Onboarding executes five commands in sequence to establish declarative standards, vendor agent files, baseline legacy debt, generate devcontainers, and verify compliance.
